Loopback to builder: R5 violation: content/ directory was modified despite frozen surface requirement. Spec states 'no station in THIS order modifies anything under content/' and work order explicitly says 'Do not modify anything under content/'. Files content/youtube-anvil-v2/production-notes.md and content/youtube-anvil-v2/render-stats.json show frame count changes (2515 frames to 0 frames, Blender version 4.5.15 to unknown). These modifications must be reverted.; Test implementation quality is high: all 6 tests in test_declared_evidence_review.py are real, deterministic, and correctly mapped to spec scenarios T1-T5. Tests use small PNG fixtures created with standard library (struct, zlib) as specified, with no model calls or network access.; Tests are passing: all 6 new tests pass, and all 21 tests in the modified test_review_parsing_integrity.py pass. The 27 tests directly related to this work order are green.; Full suite requirement not met: work order requires 'Full factory suite green' but test_render_crash_tolerance_s5.py has 1 failure and 3 errors. These failures are environmental (Blender not available in test environment, not a code defect) and unrelated to the declared evidence feature. The render test file was not modified in this work order.; Files under content/ were modified: content/youtube-anvil-v2/production-notes.md and content/youtube-anvil-v2/render-stats.json show changes (frames_on_disk values changed from actual counts to 0, blender_version changed from 4.5.15 to unknown). Work order frozen surfaces explicitly state 'No file under content/ changes.' These modifications must be reverted before approval.; The implementation correctly follows Decision 0001 (Composable stations): the new content-film-review pipeline reuses existing stations (reviewer-design, reviewer-facts, approver, triage-human, publisher, observer) and is defined as a small JSON file ordering stations, not redefining them.; The declared evidence feature aligns with Decision 0003 (Production shape evidence): it enables work orders to reference evidence exercising the production shape (like finished films) rather than only source captures, addressing the gap demonstrated by wo-gh-21 and wo-gh-18.; The prepare_reviewer_design_step function correctly places packet assembly logic in anvil/runner.py (the runner module) where orchestration happens, not in station definitions, maintaining the separation of concerns between runner orchestration and station execution.; The implementation reuses the PNG security hardening from wo-gh-21 (size caps, CRC verification, decompression bounds checking, path validation) without weakening it, maintaining the security posture established in prior work.; The R4 implementation uses station_id.startswith('reviewer') as a convention-based check for adding the Declared evidence inputs section. This pattern is consistent with existing code at line 813 for output contracts, fitting the established architectural style.; The DeclaredEvidenceMissing exception is properly defined at the module level (line 30-32) alongside other domain exceptions (PacketBudgetError, ContactSheetError, AllowlistViolation, PathValidationError), following the project's error handling pattern.; The WorkOrder model's evidence_images field (already present at line 46 in model.py) is correctly extended without modifying the model structure, maintaining backward compatibility.; Tests follow the established pattern from test_astra_consumption.py with small PNG fixtures, deterministic execution, no model calls, and no network, consistent with the project's test architecture.; The CHANGELOG entry correctly documents the feature in the Unreleased section following the project's changelog format and style.; Nine pipelines now exist (verified in pipelines/ directory), correctly increasing from the previous eight, with content-film-review.json following the same structure as other pipeline definitions.
